name: Arduino Giga R1 WiFi (STM32H747, M7 core)
note: Arduino mbed core arduino:mbed_giga, built with arduino-cli (the core the IDE uses; PlatformIO's framework-arduino-mbed is a different build of it). M7 sketch at 0x08040000 behind the Arduino bootloader, flashed by USB DFU. Pin the core to the version the sketch was proven on.

flash.bootloader_hint: Double-tap the board's RESET button. The green LED starts slowly pulsing. Then press any key here.
